description: Master metadata for the six schemes used in the AI Government Scheme Eligibility Assistant. Values are based on the provided scheme detail and FAQ documents. Fields not explicitly supported by the provided documents are null.

schemes.scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Uchchatar Shiksha Protsahan (PM-USP) Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students

study_year: Renewal: subsequent years subject to renewal conditions
eligibility.disability: 5% horizontal reservation for benchmark disabilities of 40% or more

geography.details: Fresh selection is based on the respective Board of Examination and State Education Board allocation.

eligibility.institution_type: Recognized colleges/institutions, including eligible private colleges recognized by regulatory bodies and listed on AISHE
eligibility.academic_requirement: Above the 80th percentile of successful candidates in the relevant stream in Class XII
special_conditions: Regular course only, not correspondence or distance mode
Must not receive another scholarship or fee reimbursement
Diploma students are not eligible
Students who took a drop after Class XII are not eligible for fresh application

benefit.disbursement: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to Aadhaar-seeded bank account

application.process: Fresh and renewal applications are submitted online and undergo institute/state-level verification

renewal.other_condition: Applicant should not receive scholarship from another department/ministry

documents_required: Category/Caste Certificate for reserved category students
Previous Year Mark Sheet for renewal
restrictions: No other scholarship or fee reimbursement
No distance/correspondence course
Diploma students are not eligible
Drop after Class XII makes a fresh applicant ineligible
source_documents: Pradhan Mantri Uchchatar Shiksha Protsahan (PM-USP) Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University students.pdf

geography.details: Each State/UT has a fixed scholarship quota and its own reservation norms.

eligibility.academic_requirement: Minimum 55% marks or equivalent grade in Class VII, relaxable by 5% for SC/ST students
special_conditions: Selection test is conducted at Class VIII stage
Student must qualify in Mental Ability Test (MAT) and Scholastic Aptitude Test (SAT)
Minimum 40% aggregate in MAT and SAT, or 32% for SC/ST students

benefit.maximum_duration: Four years, from Class IX to Class XII

application.process: Online registration, application form submission, document upload and verification

renewal.academic_requirement: Minimum 60% marks in Class X, relaxable by 5% for SC/ST students
renewal.promotion_requirement: Clear promotion from Class IX to X and Class XI to XII in first attempt

restrictions: Kendriya Vidyalayas are not eligible
Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalayas are not eligible
Residential schools with boarding, lodging and education facilities are not eligible
Private schools are not eligible
Studies abroad are not covered
Diploma/certificate-level courses are not covered

schemes.scheme_name: Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students (Technical Diploma)

authority.organization: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)

study_year: Second year of Diploma through lateral entry
eligibility.category: Reservation as per Government of India norms

income_limit.basis: Family income from all sources during current financial year

geography.scope: Specified Union Territories and North Eastern States
eligible_regions: Dadra and Nagar Haveli & Daman and Diu

special_conditions: Maximum two girl children per family
Must not receive another scholarship/financial assistance during the course
Course and institution must be AICTE approved

application.application_period: Refer to NSP for current dates
application.process: Apply online after the application process is announced by AICTE/NSP

renewal.requirement: Promotion Certificate duly certified by the Head of Institution
renewal.condition: Student must continue to meet renewal conditions

documents_required: HSC/12th certificate and mark sheet for Degree level where applicable
ITI certificate and mark sheet for Diploma lateral entry where applicable
Diploma certificate and mark sheet for Degree lateral entry where applicable
restrictions: Only female students are eligible
Maximum two girl children per family
Students receiving other Central Government, State Government or AICTE-sponsored scholarships are not eligible
Students in non-technical or non-AICTE-approved courses/institutions are not eligible
Postgraduate students are not eligible
Failed/dropped-out students are not eligible for further scholarship

schemes.scheme_name: Post-Graduate Scholarships for Professional Courses for SC/ST Candidates

institution_type: Institutions under Sections 2(f) and 12(B) of UGC Act
Eligible deemed universities under Section 3 of UGC Act
Universities/institutions/colleges funded by Central or State Government
eligibility.academic_requirement: Graduate degree in the relevant subject and admission to a regular full-time professional postgraduate course
special_conditions: Only first-year postgraduate students in the current academic year may apply
Courses requiring approval from specified regulatory councils are treated as professional courses
M.A., M.Sc., M.Com., MSW and Mass Communication and Journalism are identified as non-professional courses

benefit.duration: Two or three years depending on postgraduate course tenure
benefit.contingency: No contingency payable from selection year 2017-18
benefit.disbursement: UGC pattern through designated bank branches

application.application_period: Once a year after UGC advertisement
application.process: Online registration, OTP verification and application submission

renewal.requirement: Annual progress report and good conduct/prescribed attendance
renewal.restriction: Change in course of study is not permitted
renewal.promotion: Failure to get promoted results in forfeiture of scholarship

restrictions: General category and OBC candidates are not eligible
Correspondence and distance education professional postgraduate courses are not eligible
Failure to pass the first year in first division or equivalent CGPA may result in cancellation
False information or incorrect bank details may result in cancellation
Discontinuation of studies may result in cancellation
source_documents: Post-Graduate Scholarships for Professional Courses for SC_ST Candidates.pdf
Post-Graduate Scholarships for Professional Courses for SC/ST Candidates FAQ.pdf

schemes.scheme_name: Free Education for Sports Medal Winners / Participants of National / International Events

institution_type: Universities/institutions/colleges under Sections 2(f) and 12(B) of UGC Act
Eligible deemed universities under Section 3 of UGC Act
special_conditions: Medal winners of National Games may be eligible
Participants in recognized international sporting events may be eligible
International events must be recognized by the World University Service, International Olympic Committee, or Olympic Committee of Asia
Subsequent-year assistance depends on subsequent sports performance

benefit.tuition_fee: Actual or specified percentage of actual depending on sports achievement
benefit.special_courses_abroad: As per Government of India norms
benefit.kit_allowance: Varies by level of sports achievement
examples: Olympics/World Championship categories: Kit ₹15,000 per annum
Other achievement categories may have lower kit allowances and/or specified percentage of tuition support
benefit.disbursement: Financial assistance reimbursed by UGC to the university concerned

application.process: Complete prescribed form, attach participation/medal certificate attested by Registrar/Principal, verify and submit through designated authority

renewal.requirement: Subsequent sports performance and academic progress
renewal.progress_requirement: Progress report submitted after the first year

documents_required: Certificate of participation/medal winning attested by Registrar/Principal
restrictions: UGC may terminate assistance for misconduct
Unsatisfactory academic progress may result in termination
Continuation is subject to sports performance and institutional recommendation
source_documents: Free Education For Sports Medal Winners _ Participants Of National_ International Events.pdf
FAQ for Free Education for Sports Medal Winners / Participants of National / International Events.pdf

study_year: Undergraduate: completed/appeared in second year/4th semester
Graduate/PG: completed/appeared in first year/2nd semester of postgraduate programme

geography.details: Recognized University/Institution within India or abroad

academic_requirement: Undergraduate: at least 85% or equivalent in Class XII
Graduate/PG/research: at least 70% or equivalent in Graduation
Completed/final-exam candidates: at least 70% cumulative marks in graduation/postgraduation
special_conditions: Completed-study applicants must begin the internship within six months of final result declaration
Attendance must be at least 75%
Selected applicant must produce original marksheets and NOC at joining
Applicant must have their own laptop
Only one area of interest may be selected

benefit.certificate: Experience Certificate/Internship Completion Certificate on successful completion
other_benefits: Exposure to Government functioning and developmental policy issues
Working space and internet facility as deemed fit by concerned NITI Aayog heads

application.process: Online form submission, area of interest selection, preview/edit, final submission and application status tracking

renewal.reapplication: Allowed after rejection once eligibility requirements are met
renewal.repeat_internship: Allowed, but only once in a financial year

documents_required: Graduation/PG marksheets and degree as applicable
restrictions: Unpaid internship
First-year undergraduate students cannot apply
Selection is subject to discretion of selectors
Only selected applicants are contacted
Only one internship is allowed in a financial year
Incomplete eligibility results in rejection
